name: section_intro
label: Section intro
default: Select a location to view available dates, pricing and booking options for this course.

name: session_card_image
label: Default session card image
help_text: Used when a HubDB session row does not have its own photo/OG image. To change one specific card image, edit that session row in HubDB.

name: session_card_category_label
label: Fallback card category label
help_text: Used only when a HubDB session row does not have a category.

name: session_card_delivery_label
label: Fallback delivery label
help_text: Used only when a HubDB session row does not have a delivery mode or city.

name: worker_portal_id
label: Worker portal id override
help_text: Sent to the Event Engine worker as X-Portal-Id when reading live seat availability. Defaults to this HubSpot account's Hub ID. Set only if the worker keys tenants on a different id.

name: default_city
label: Default city (optional override)
help_text: On the standard course detail template this is set to Any, which lists every session for the course across all locations - the same All locations behaviour as the /courses timetable - and the visitor narrows it with the selector. Elsewhere, First available pre-selects the first city that has sessions. Locations come from the courses HubDB "city" SELECT.

name: default_delivery_mode
label: Default delivery type
help_text: The delivery-type filter only appears when this course has sessions across more than one delivery mode. Values must match the 'delivery_mode' Select options in the courses HubDB table.

name: contact_cta_label
label: Contact fallback CTA label
help_text: Used when an imported session does not have Event Engine booking or a valid external registration URL.

name: eoi_form
label: EOI form (used when no city sessions)
help_text: Select the HubSpot expression-of-interest form to show when no sessions match.

name: eoi_message
label: EOI message
default: We don’t have a session scheduled here yet - register your interest and we’ll let you know.

name: section_id
label: Section anchor ID (optional)
help_text: Used for in-page anchor links. Lower-case, hyphenated. Leave blank if not needed.

name: members_only
label: Members only
help_text: When true, this section is only rendered for logged-in active members.
